node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e places offering in Scope; node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5, node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5, node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 place promotional conditions in Scope. False conditions therefore produce OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than a negative prohibition answer or positive selected-control compliance answer. Preserve both interpretations until the question domain explicitly distinguishes applicability from substantive failure of a prohibition condition.

The offer-level candidates combine an offer-level promotional connection with an existential non-discount gift test. For mixed offers, establish that the same gift component has the required promotional connection; otherwise the formulas may impose an unsupported restriction.

Unit db43e253bea18.u0.2 defines distributors as intermediaries distributing SFC-authorised funds. Broader candidate terminology must remain within that source scope unless a broader paragraph 3.11 assessment is separately supported.

Unit db43e253bea18.u12.2646 says guaranteed returns or incentives may be gifts. Neither automatic prohibition nor automatic exemption follows. Gift classification remains supplied judgment, and selected gift-control compliance is not overall regulatory compliance.

node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b correctly focuses on attributed offering, but its categorical funding and fulfilment independence is not expressly settled by the source. Offering does not require completed payment; attribution in third-party arrangements remains unresolved.

No external dependencies are supplied. Independent validation of the gift standard requires the applicable Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and question 1 of the SFC FAQ issued on 30 September 2010. Broader advertising validation requires paragraph 2.3, the named Advertising Guidelines and applicable supplements. Verification of the underlying disclosure duty requires Handbook Overarching Principles section 6.4. These missing texts do not prevent assessment of the circular's express claims.
